item.tib: byams ma shes rab blo 'phel gyi nyer mkho'i shog chung gsal byed sgron ma
item.coloph: nyer mkho'i shog chung gsal byed sgron ma zhes bya ba/ sgo rigs kyi drang srong nyi ma bstan 'dzin dbang rgyal du 'bod pas/ g.yas ru bkra shis sman ri'i bla brang rtse mor sbyar ba dge des rjes 'jug smon pa'i blo mun bsal nas/ rig gnas bon gyi bstan pa dar zhing rgyas pa'i rgyu gyur cig/
